evidence_scope: CPU NumPy/PyTorch tests and actual Warp1.18 CPU kernel execution; no CUDA claim

findings.issue: Hidden peer position/battery changed default mask/action
findings.decision: Default HELLO-local peer selection; explicit legacy mode retained

findings.issue: Observation preview changed next packet payload
findings.decision: Read-only preview and masks

findings.issue: Team EWMA snapshots fused without current-age discount
findings.decision: Age each source on end-step clock

findings.issue: Scaled/sizable fleets began inside unsafe separation or buildings
findings.decision: Preserve valid spawn; validated bounded fallback

findings.issue: Full RF bridge still required six UAVs and seven destinations
findings.decision: Use actual fleet and mask dimensions

findings.issue: Instantaneous penalty used running mean
findings.decision: Use current censored map age, keep time-average metric

findings.issue: Older novel support caused confirmation but latency stayed zero
findings.decision: Track novel receipt independently of newest generation receipt

findings.issue: Expired/zero-hop HELLO entries selected by new local default
findings.decision: Consistent read-only active-route filter for action/mask/telemetry

findings.issue: CPU coalescing could not be selected via EnvConfig
findings.decision: Expose validated False-default protocol option

findings.issue: Packet could expire in DIFS/backoff then transmit
findings.decision: Recheck lifetime at actual TX start

findings.issue: In-flight expired packet delivered at destination
findings.decision: Physical ACK preserved; expired app payload rejected

findings.issue: Full relay marked packet dedup before admission
findings.decision: Commit dedup only after enqueue

findings.issue: Renewed old identity could lose E2E pending lifecycle
findings.decision: Preserve live expiry, prune expired identities, restore live pending

findings.issue: Own 62 entries could starve relay origins; preview advanced cursor
findings.decision: Rotate all origins only on new admitted packet

findings.issue: Accepted grid1 collapsed cell buffers to scalar
findings.decision: Collapse only named environment scalar fields

findings.issue: Exactly enough events incorrectly overflowed
findings.decision: Inspect remaining due events and preserve sticky fault

findings.issue: Disabling host checks could permit invalid state progression
findings.decision: Device blocks overflow/clock/generation faults until reset

findings.issue: Non-target ACK overhearers kept RX locks
findings.decision: Release all locks belonging to finishing ACK TX

findings.issue: Expired routes entered advertised DV
findings.decision: Prune before HELLO snapshot

findings.issue: Injected queue waited for next HELLO
findings.decision: Arm idle work at step start

findings.issue: Lost ACK duplicated relay custody; retry drops uncounted
findings.decision: Hop-ID ring after admission and drop counter

findings.issue: Expired data assimilated on final Warp delivery
findings.decision: No expired application delivery; physical ACK preserved

findings.issue: Same evidence with new app sequence renewed freshness
findings.decision: Update evidence receipt only for novel snapshot

findings.issue: Warp nearest selector read hidden peer truth
findings.decision: Default unexpired local HELLO route-distance choice

findings.issue: Bool/fraction dimensions, invalid eta and unsupported raw mode accepted
findings.decision: Validate before allocation; reject raw mode

findings.issue: Missing torch could bypass CUDA allocation guard
findings.decision: Query free memory through Warp directly

findings.issue: Same source/cell timestamp could silently lose new counts in watermark
findings.decision: Prevalidate per env, fault3 before mutation, guarded ValueError and reset recovery

findings.issue: Kaggle token prefix was not recognized
findings.decision: Synthetic regression and Kaggle token pattern

findings.issue: Old smoke/source strings did not prove payload delivery
findings.decision: Shared real CPU/CUDA workload plus endpoint consistency fixture

findings.issue: Count-weight DS was described as identical per-sample mass discount
findings.decision: Correct claims; include numeric counterexample; retain main algorithm

findings.issue: Legacy folder test scanned third-party .venv packages after documented install
findings.decision: Use canonical source inventory, as full policy checker already does

findings.issue: Motion/sensing/belief/reward/obs/replay/update/eval not integrated
findings.decision: Implement and field-compare full device environment after packet gates

findings.issue: No exact CPU-Warp event trace parity
findings.decision: Define trace schema, deterministic controlled collisions/loss/reset cases and tolerances

findings.issue: No local CUDA; authorized account02 token inactive
findings.decision: Refresh account2 token then bounded T4x2 CUDA gates

findings.issue: No SimPy/UavNetSim distribution experiment
findings.decision: PDR/delay/retry/queue comparisons against pinned upstream

findings.issue: Queues/pending/RNG/dedup/fairness/RF configuration differ across implementations
findings.decision: Align scope before scientific runtime or policy comparison

findings.issue: BBA threshold and sensor assumptions not empirically calibrated
findings.decision: Matched mass/threshold variants and precision/recall/false confirms

findings.issue: Perfect-state shield and airframe/RF power model are assumptions
findings.decision: Report assumptions and validate local sensing / hardware parameters

findings.issue: No converged multi-seed training or live tracking integration
findings.decision: Communication controls, paired eval seeds, confidence intervals, explicit logger pipeline
